A '''coolant refinery''' was located in the forests of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], and after it exploded during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who came to study the effect that the enormous chemical leak had on the environment found that the wildlife around the refinery actually thrived in the aftermath of the explosion.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Accidents Happen}}</ref>
